chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: McDonald's India (North & East) menu booklet with nutrition and allergens (20 Nov 2026). McDonald's India publishes Calories; kilojoules are worked out. Restaurants in the west and south are run by a different company that publishes Calories only, and their recipes can differ

chains.name: KFC
chains.src: KFC India Nutrition Information booklet, version 6 (20 Nov 2026), one serve of each item. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. No allergens: the booklet shows them as pictures

chains.name: Pizza Hut
chains.src: Pizza Hut India Nutrition & Allergen Information Booklet (20 Nov 2026). Pizzas are the whole pizza, one row per size and crust. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out

chains.name: Barbeque Nation
chains.src: Barbeque Nation "Nutritive value of served food items" (barbequenation.com/documents/nutrition-information.pdf, effective 30 August 2025), mostly per 100 g as served from the buffet; also UBQ delivery dishes and monthly festival dishes. Calories as published; kilojoules are worked out. No allergens: the list has no sesame. No beef or pork; mutton is goat. Dishes the menu lists under VEGETARIAN are marked vegetarian. Left out 11 cocktails, 27 meals/mini meals/platters, 50 repeated rows (the NEW version kept), and 43 row(s) whose calories don't match their macros, mostly the soya chaap dishes and the chicken tangdi (drumstick) dishes, whose calories run 60-80% above their macros. (22 Nov 2026)
